confirmed_all_road_inventory.scope: Total Uganda Road Network (National, District, Urban and Community Access Roads)
confirmed_all_road_inventory.source: National Road Network NATIONAL ROAD NETWORK ADMINISTRATION authoritative register

calculation_policy: Use 173,785.00 km total Uganda road network, 21,284.02 km National Road Network (6,406.69 km paved and 14,877.33 km unpaved), 552 bridges and 452 major culverts for FY 2026/27 reporting.
Express all network extent, condition and allocation metrics strictly in kilometres (km) and percentages (%).
Retain missing observations as Not supplied; do not fabricate values or geometry.
Condition surveys follow MOBICAP(Road condition assesment tool) and ROMDAS(Roughness and rutting machine based testing) standards.
All projections align to Vision 2040 with dd/mm/yyyy date formatting and metric units.

geospatial_reconciliation_policy.geometry_rule: Do not scale, clone or fabricate geometry.
geospatial_reconciliation_policy.public_reporting_rule: Public dashboards use the authoritative baseline of 173,785.00 km total Uganda road network, 21,284.02 km National Road Network (6,406.69 km paved, 14,877.33 km unpaved), 552 bridges and 452 major culverts for FY 2026/27.
